definitions.explanation: Being at an early stage of life.
Having characteristics of a young child.

examples.japanese: {幼|おさな}い⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧。
{幼|おさな}い⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧。

examples.english: He has liked drawing since he was very young.

examples.japanese: ⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{幼|おさな}い。
⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{幼|おさな}い。
⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧なのに、やること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{幼|おさな}くて⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: Even though they're an adult, their behavior is so childish it's troubling.

notes:
{幼|おさな}い is an i-adjective describing early childhood (roughly ages 1-6) or childlike/immature qualities.

TWO MEANINGS:
1. Very young (neutral): {幼|おさな}い⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧ (young child)
2. Immature/childish (negative): ⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{幼|おさな}い (thinking is immature)

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {幼|おさな}く
- Noun form: ⟦{幼|おさな}さ→幼さ：27926_osanasa⟧ (youth, immaturity)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {幼|おさな}い⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧: in early childhood
- ⟦{幼馴染|おさななじ}み→幼馴染み：12429_osananajimi⟧: childhood friend
- {幼|おさな}い⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: childlike face

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幼|おさな}い: very young (early childhood, or immature)
- ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧: young (broader age range, teens to young adults)
- ⟦{子供|こども}っぽい→子供っぽい：16825_kodomoppoi⟧: childish (often pejorative)

RELATED:
- ⟦{幼児|ようじ}→幼児：12478_youji⟧: infant, young child
- ⟦{幼稚園|ようちえん}→幼稚園：04703_youchien⟧: kindergarten
